Stata's nlswork, filed as stata_nlswork:nlswork.dta: ETL/wages_etl.R keeps 15 covariates, ln_wage and idcode, keeps a missing year, ind_code, occ_code or race as a level of its own, drops every other row with a missing value (28013 rows remain) and dummy-codes the four. Sigrist 2023 (Table 1 Wages, run_experiments.R) fits ln_wage ~ covariates + (1 | idcode) + (0 + t | idcode) + (0 + I(t^2) | idcode), t = year - 78, the slopes uncorrelated; the squared age, ttl_exp and tenure appear only in a commented-out lme4 formula (hand check #162).
